b: Ok so I'm making this post because I've previously made a post about algo demotion and how to get out of it.

I've been wondering a lot what really matters in 2026 SEO. Most people were saying that the backlinks (relevant backlinks) is what matters the most. Then you need to have a good website, without too many pages, the pages have to be good quality and made for query intentions.

The thing is that I was looking at my competitors, 3 of my competitors have 100k+ visitors / month on semrush, they exist since july, they don't have any relevant backlink, only the yahoo junk backlinks...
So how? Why they have 100k+ visitors when other competitors can't get over 1k visitors a month.
I think (that's my opinion) that what matters the most nowadays in the eyes of Google is the visitors you have, and the footprint you have through social medias.
What those 3 websites have in common is that they had a discord/reddit community, or a X community (from the founder), ...
I don't fully know how to explain it, but I'm pretty sure that it's what matters the most in 2026 (before the november core update, maybe it'll change things).
